newsitem.title: USA: Thermwood to open Austrian sales office.
newsitem.headline: Thermwood to open Austrian sales office.

text.p: Thermwood Corp said Tuesday it expects to open a sales office in Austria by the end of this fiscal year to service the European market.
Thermwood also has a sales, services and demonstration facility in Durham, England.

"We believe the total European market for woodworking machines is $1.2 billion, approximately 50 percent greater than the U.S.," Kenneth Susnjara, president, said in a statement. "Due to our low-cost manufacturing approach, Thermwood machine pricing is substantially below competing European-made machines, even after shipment and duty."
Thermwood, which makes computer-based production systems, said about 10 percent of its new orders have come from international markets.

Earlier, Thermwood reported earnings for the second quarter ended January 31 of $0.04 a share, up from $0.02 a year ago. Current second quarter results included $233,913 in income taxes, compared with no taxes paid a year ago because of loss carryforward benefits.
Backlog increased to about $2,500,000 during the second quarter from $1,800,000 at the end of the preceding quarter, the company said.
